summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan for the post-incident uncommitted-state verification checklist. Phase 1 authors the one-page standards file in agent-system/extensions/core/context/standards/; Phases 2 and 3 (parallel) register it in index-entries.json and add the pointer inside the guard's stash_revert-only refusal block; Phase 4 redeploys and runs the full gate set. The plan also closes the research report's open question: the index source is the core manifest's index-entries.json, not a hand-edited deployed index.json.

artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan: author the one-page checklist, register it in the context index, add the guard refusal cross-reference, redeploy and verify.
